Full job description

Overview
Realdrseattle is seeking an experienced Cross-Platform Mobile App Developer with a strong focus on React Native to build and maintain high-quality mobile apps for iOS and Android. You will work in a fast-paced environment, prioritize clean code, and create smooth, visually compelling user experiences.

Important: This is an in-person position in Noida, Delhi (NOT REMOTE).
Responsibilities

  • Develop & Maintain Cross-Platform Applications
  • Use React Native (JavaScript/TypeScript) to build Android and iOS apps.

Optimize Performance & Responsiveness

  • Implement smooth animations, fast load times, and minimal UI lag.
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks related to rendering or bridging.

Implement Native-Like UI/UX

  • Collaborate with designers to ensure pixel-perfect interfaces and platform-consistent user experiences.
  • Leverage React Native’s native components for best-in-class UI.

Full-Stack & Back-End Integration

  • Connect apps to REST/GraphQL APIs or other services (e.g., Firebase, Node.js).
  • Collaborate with back-end teams or build back-end functionality if full-stack.

Code Quality & Testing

  • Write clean, maintainable code and follow version control best practices (Git).
  • Implement unit tests, integration tests, and automated UI tests when applicable.

Stay Current on Emerging Technologies

  • Keep up with updates in React Native and relevant best practices.
  • Proactively suggest improvements and new features.

Production Support & Maintenance

  • Troubleshoot issues and release timely updates to app stores.
  • Provide ongoing support to ensure app stability and performance.

Qualifications

Required

  • 3+ years of professional experience with React Native (portfolio or published apps a plus).
  • Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Understanding of iOS and Android development environments (Xcode, Android Studio, simulators).
  • Familiarity with REST APIs, JSON, and standard mobile app architectures (MVC, MVVM, etc.).
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work independently or in a small team.

Preferred

  • Knowledge of performance optimization, debugging tools, and CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, etc.).
  • Exposure to Firebase, Node.js, or other modern back-end stacks.
  • BS in Computer Science or related field (or equivalent work experience).

Schedule & Work Type

  • Job Type: Full-time, In-Person (Not Remote)
  • Shift: Monday to Friday, Night Shift, US Shift
  • Location: Noida Sector 62, Noida, Uttar Pradesh (must reliably commute or plan to relocate before starting)

Compensation & Benefits

  • Pay: ₹1,30,000.00 - ₹1,60,000.00 per month
  • Benefits: Paid time off

Education & Experience

  • Education: Bachelor’s (Preferred)
  • Experience: React/React Native: 3 years (Required)
